match_note: The reviewed manuscript differs substantially from arXiv v1. The title changed from 'Stabilization of a polar phase in WO3 thin films by epitaxial strain' to 'Polarity and anti-distortive polarons in WO3 through epitaxial shear strain'. The reviewed version includes material absent from v1: anti-distortive polaron claims, Hall-bar transport (Fig. 5c), and lateral PFM phase in Fig. 1b (v1 Fig. 1b is a geometry schematic). It also cites SI figures S5–S9 (v1 SI has only five figures) and Lee et al./Hassani et al. framing. Core structural content is common to both: Table 1, Fig. 2 RSMs, the phase transition, iDPC-STEM ellipticity, and domain scaling in Fig. 4.

concerns.quote: the phase difference between adjacent in-plane polarization domains appears to be approximately 40°, rather than the expected 180° for antiparallel polarization directions.
concerns.summary: The lateral PFM phase contrast between stripe domains is about 40° rather than the 180° expected for antiparallel polarization.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: the two diffraction peaks along the [100]_YAO direction maintain the same separation as the diffraction order increases. Could the authors clarify why these peaks do not exhibit the distinct triclinic domain behavior
concerns.summary: It is unclear why peak splitting grows with diffraction order along one direction but stays constant along the orthogonal one.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: the analytical procedure and statistical basis for extracting the crystallographic parameters are not sufficiently described. Providing details on the refinement method, fitting constraints, and error analysis
concerns.summary: The refinement method, constraints and error analysis behind the Table 1 lattice parameters are not described.

concerns.quote: the manuscript does not explain the additional splitting along q_z. A more detailed description of the triclinic domain geometry... and explicit peak-to-domain mapping, would greatly aid reader comprehension.
concerns.summary: Diffraction peaks need explicit assignment to real-space triclinic domain variants, including an explanation of the q_z splitting.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: the discussion remains qualitative. A quantitative analysis of the shear strain imposed on WO3—its magnitude, tensor components, and orientation—would significantly strengthen the argument
concerns.summary: The shear-strain mechanism tied to the 91.5° substrate angle needs a quantitative strain-tensor analysis.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: If temperature-dependent shear strain values for YAlO3(001) are available... correlating them with the temperature-dependent structural evolution of WO3 (Figure 2f) would deepen the discussion
concerns.summary: The temperature dependence of the substrate shear strain should be correlated with the film's structural transitions.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: adding directional labels would prevent potential misinterpretation that the polarization direction rotates with increasing film thickness.
concerns.summary: Fig. 4a–c lacks orientation labels: R1 warned this suggests a rotating polarization, R3 read it as a real rotation needing explanation, and R3 also asked about multi-state storage.

concerns.quote: an experimental study on WO3 has already been published (G. Lee et al., Small 21, e04162 (2025)). The authors should clarify whether the present manuscript provides additional or more direct evidence
concerns.summary: The claim of the first observation of anti-distortive polarons may be undermined by prior experimental work.

concerns.quote: can the phenomenon still be classified as a polaron...? Alternatively, could the enhanced conduction be explained by the higher structural symmetry and reduced band gap at the domain wall
concerns.summary: Domain-wall conduction may come from a pre-existing undistorted structure with a reduced band gap rather than from polarons.

concerns.quote: it is unclear how this mechanism would contribute to transport measured perpendicular to the stripe walls. In such a configuration, bulk conduction with higher activation energy would be expected to dominate.
concerns.summary: It is unclear why polaronic transport would be relevant for conduction measured perpendicular to the domain walls.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: A new polar and piezoelectric phase is stabilized in epitaxial WO3 thin films. Have the authors performed secondary harmonic generation (SHG) measurements
concerns.summary: SHG measurements are requested to support the claimed polar phase.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: What's the relationship between Fig. 1(b) and Fig. S2(b)? Why are the two images presented in a mirror symmetric manner?
concerns.summary: Two apparently identical PFM images are shown mirrored without explanation.

concerns.quote: are confusing, as the experiment details are not clear, such as fast scanning axis and sample orientation.
concerns.summary: Statements about vertical-channel PFM contrast need a schematic of cantilever orientation, scan axes and more detail on Fig. S5.

concerns.quote: Could the authors perform the domain switching utilizing the mechanical trailing field of the PFM scanning tip?
concerns.summary: Mechanical switching of domains with the PFM tip is requested.

concerns.quote: could the authors clarify "in one of four directions" in line 166-167?
concerns.summary: The description of the four domain orientations relative to the substrate axis is unclear.

concerns.quote: The statement in line 174-175 contradicts Fig. S8, as the bottom diffraction spot exists when temperature is above 600 °C. Do the bottom two spots disappear or merge
concerns.summary: The text on spot disappearance during the phase transition contradicts the supplementary RSMs.

concerns.quote: Could the authors present in supplementary file the RSM data of WO3 films with a thickness larger than 250 nm?
concerns.summary: RSM data are requested for films thicker than 250 nm to support the claimed relaxation to the monoclinic phase.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: The iDPC-STEM image quality in Fig. 3 is inadequate to give accurate information on the oxygen octahedral tilt pattern... maybe due to a thick TEM sample, giving large error on the fitting
concerns.summary: iDPC-STEM image quality, likely limited by sample thickness, is too poor for reliable oxygen-column ellipticity and tilt analysis.

concerns.quote: a structural diagram of the P1 phase, supported by theoretical calculations, would help confirm its proposed configuration.
concerns.summary: A structural model of the proposed P1 phase, ideally supported by calculations, is requested.

concerns.quote: The authors emphasize the critical role of epitaxial shear strain in stabilizing the polar triclinic phase. To strengthen this claim, additional experimental and theoretical evidence should be provided.
concerns.summary: The claim that shear strain stabilizes the phase needs further experimental and theoretical support.

concerns.quote: What's the role of oxygen vacancy on the domain-wall conductivity? It will be great if the authors could provide insights... by performing electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS)
concerns.summary: Oxygen vacancies may explain the domain-wall conductivity, and EELS at the walls is requested to test this.

concerns.quote: The authors are advised to provide the image of fabricated Hall bar and the raw data of electrical measurements in supplementary file.
concerns.summary: Hall-bar device images and raw electrical data are requested.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: There are several errors or typos need to be corrected, such as those in the captions of Fig. 1 and Fig. S9.
concerns.summary: Figure captions contain typos and errors.

concerns.quote: The reviewer is wondering how the authors define the oxygen octahedral tilts in the WO3 film, especially the P1 phase.
concerns.summary: The definition of the octahedral tilt pattern in the P1 phase is unclear.

concerns.quote: The amplitude units in Figs. 1a and 1d are given in mV... it is recommended that the authors convert the amplitude scale to picometers (pm).
concerns.summary: PFM amplitudes should be reported in pm rather than mV.

concerns.quote: a noticeable contrast variation between the left and right sides appears to result from acquisition artifacts... Figs. S3 and S4 exhibit skip/slip artifacts or are substantially influenced by surface topography
concerns.summary: PFM images contain acquisition and topography artifacts and should be replaced with better scans.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: it would be helpful to provide a more detailed description of the image processing and data extraction procedures... clarifying how the accuracy of the extracted ellipticity for the oxygen atomic columns was defined.
concerns.summary: The STEM ellipticity extraction procedure and its accuracy are not described.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

later_concerns.quote: the referee strongly recommends that the authors provide more comprehensive experimental data or theoretical calculations to further validate the structure of the proposed new phase.
later_concerns.summary: The crystal structure of the new phase still needs more experimental or theoretical validation.

later_concerns.quote: the referee recommends that the authors further optimize the TEM sample thickness in order to obtain higher-quality iDPC-STEM images.
later_concerns.summary: iDPC-STEM images should be retaken on thinner lamellae to visualize the oxygen sublattice reliably.
later_concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis
